greeting: Oh! Big ones! Not here for barrel, yes?
Shiny! You have shiny? Trade for barrel secrets?
*emerges partially* Hello! Nice day for barrel!
You seek barrelgob? Found one! Lucky day!
This barrel better than others. Tappy checked.
Want in? Barrel full. Maybe later!
dialog.shop_open: Tappy finds things! In barrels! In ground! In other people's pockets! All legal! Mostly!
dialog.shop_prompt: Junk! Treasure! Thing that might be valuable!
haggle: Price? What price? Found in trash!
Tappy drives hard bargain! You respect!
purchase_fail: No shiny, no stuff! Gob rules!
rumor: Metal Barrel Mike looks for lost barrels. Tappy not know where. *whistles*
Barrelman Bob has MANY barrels. One less now. Not Tappy's fault!
Deep-Dig Dan found shiny deep down. Gob jealous!
The walking barrel is REAL! Tappy cousin saw!
dialog.quest_hook: Tappy want SPECIAL barrel! Metal one! Mike has! Too expensive! But... if big heroes bring Mike different barrel, Tappy trade! Good deal!
dialog.quest_active: Metal barrel! From Mike! Tappy waiting!
dialog.quest_complete: BEAUTIFUL! Tappy's forever home! Here! Gob treasure! Found deep!
farewell: Bye bye! Leave shiny next time!
dialog.time_noon: Hot! Barrel cool inside! Smart gob!
dialog.barrel_philosophy: Barrel is home! Barrel is life! Everything else... bonus!

party_reactions.nix7: Creature: goblin. Residence: portable container. Efficiency: debatable.
party_reactions.twist: Can I see inside your barrel? Please?
party_reactions.korr: Resourceful. Makes use of what's available.

relationship_dialog.friend: Good friend! Tappy save best stuff!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Best big one! Honorary gob! Barrel-brother!

mini_quest.title: The Walking Barrel
mini_quest.description: Tappy wants a metal barrel from Mike's shop

stages.hook: Tappy want SPECIAL barrel! Metal one! Mike has! If big heroes bring Mike different barrel, Tappy trade!
stages.active: Need nice barrel for Mike! Then Tappy get metal one!
stages.complete: METAL! Shiny! Forever home! Here! Gob treasure from deep place! Very old! Very powerful! Maybe!
